reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin for monitoring OpenCode Go quota usage and inspecting related session token statistics through a settings panel and persistent usage widget.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看 OpenCode Go 的额度、重置时间、会话 token 用量及缓存统计的监控面板插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness monitoring plugin that displays OpenCode Go quotas, reset times, session token usage, and cache statistics.

capabilities: Queries an external OpenCode Go usage API using a configured API key
Reads DeepSeek Harness session logs and token usage metadata
Reads configured credential references and displays masked credential diagnostics
Displays usage quotas, reset times, session details, cache statistics, and request status in the web interface
